Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 cnt NUMBER ;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;


 BEGIN
 nullchk;
 IF :ctrl_block_1.contract_type = 'IN' AND 
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id = 'INTERNAL' 
 THEN
 BEGIN 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 GO_BLOCK('contract_tests');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.contract_id IS NULL 
 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('contract_tests');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT company 
 INTO :ctrl_block_1.company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id AND 
 --SYSDATE between SYSDATE AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1) ; ---- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN v_local_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10) 
 ;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 GO_BLOCK('contract_tests');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO cnt
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 UPPER(company) LIKE '%'||UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(:ctrl_block_1.contract_id)))||'%' AND 
 --SYSDATE between SYSDATE AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1) ; -- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN v_local_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10) 
 ;
 IF cnt = 0 
 THEN 
 show_error ('5150');
 ELSIF cnt = 1 
 THEN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company
 INTO :ctrl_block_1.contract_id
 ,:ctrl_block_1.company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 UPPER(COMPANY) LIKE '%'||UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(:ctrl_block_1.contract_id)))||'%' AND 
 --SYSDATE between SYSDATE AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1) ; -- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN v_local_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10) 
 ;
 ELSE
 LIST_VALUES ;
 END IF ;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF ;
 END ;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: CHECK_DUP_TESTID
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 currec number ;
 curtestid VARCHAR2(12) ;
begin

 currec := :system.cursor_record ;
 curtestid := :contract_tests.test_id ;
 first_record ;
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record != currec
 and :contract_tests.test_id = curtestid then
 go_record(currec) ;
 show_error('5163') ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE' ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 go_record(currec) ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_CONTRACT_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_contract_id is
 last_contract_id VARCHAR2(9) := NULL;
begin
begin
 select max(contract_id)
 into last_contract_id
 from contracts
 where contract_id like :global.chapter_id || 'TS%';
exception
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
--
if last_contract_id is null
then
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id := :global.chapter_id ||
 'TS' || '0001';
else
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id :=
 substr(last_contract_id,1,5) ||
 lpad(to_char(to_number(substr(last_contract_id,6,4))+1),4,'0');
end if;
--
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PASS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_pass is
/* This procedure was modified by Edwin on 7-16-2001. If the Parameter value is Y in the menu item then 
 the password window will come. If it is N or null then it will not come but the data will be committed.
 But if the value is other than those then error will come up
*/

begin
 default_value ('NULL','global.PASSWD');
 IF name_in('global.PASSWD') is not null then
 if name_in('global.PASSWD') = 'Y' or name_in('global.PASSWD')='y' then
 copy('N','GLOBAL.commit_yes');
 CALL_FORM( lower('SYSPASS') ,no_hide);
 elsif name_in('global.PASSWD') = 'N' or name_in('global.PASSWD') = 'n' then
 copy('Y','GLOBAL.commit_yes');
 else 
 message('Invalid Value was entered for the parameter name 1 in the menu item. Valid values are Y , N or NULL1null ',no_acknowledge); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 Else
 copy('Y','GLOBAL.commit_yes');
 End if;

 if name_in('GLOBAL.commit_yes') = 'Y' then
 commit;
 end if;
end;
